_readme: What bootstrap installs, per layer. Add a line here, run `aos update` (or bootstrap.ps1 -Layer base).
The two agent CLIs are not listed: both use their vendor's own installer, which auto-updates.
(winget's OpenAI.Codex was tried on 2026-09-27: without Developer Mode it cannot create the `codex` alias.)
The ChatGPT/Codex desktop app comes from the Microsoft Store (9PLM9XGG6VKS) and updates there.

base.why: git, plus Git Bash, which gives Claude Code its Bash tool
gh: PRs, issues and Actions from both agents, without an MCP server
PowerShell 7 (pwsh), MSI edition: the default MSIX edition can't see tools in AppData (codex, npm globals)
Python for scripts and the knowledge-base tools (py launcher)
uv/uvx: Python envs and tools without polluting the global Python
rg: the search tool both agents reach for first
jq: JSON on the command line (CLI --json outputs)
fzf: fuzzy picking in the terminal
delta: readable diffs when reviewing agent work
editor for reviewing diffs; hosts the Claude Code and Codex extensions

local.why: local model runtime (CUDA on the GTX 1660 Ti); models live in ~\.ollama

media.why: ffmpeg/ffprobe full build: cut, convert, loudness, subtitles (about 250 MB)
magick: resize, convert and batch images (about 25 MB)
pandoc: markdown, docx, html, epub conversion (about 40 MB)
yt-dlp: fetch reference media; --skip-dependencies avoids a second ffmpeg (about 17 MB)
deno: the JS runtime yt-dlp needs for some YouTube sites (about 95 MB)
duckdb: SQL over CSV, JSON and Parquet with no server (about 12 MB)
inkscape: vector graphics with a full command line (about 165 MB)
blender: 3D and motion, scriptable with blender -b --python (about 350 MB)
obs: scripted screen recording over its WebSocket (about 150 MB)
kdenlive: video editor whose projects are text and render with melt (about 135 MB)
lmms: music production, projects render from the command line (about 35 MB)

local_npm.name: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
local_npm.why: Pi: the agent harness on the local model, run by Paseo's pi provider (config in ~\.pi\agent)

phone_npm.name: @getpaseo/cli
phone_npm.why: Paseo: the daemon the Paseo phone app connects to (state in ~\.paseo)

npm.name: ccusage
npm.why: local usage/limit reports and the Claude Code status line
